image_description: Two cloth diapers placed on a beige textured carpet. The larger diaper on the left is primarily dark blue with a colorful patterned waistband (teal, orange, red geometric shapes). The smaller diaper on the right features a black front panel with a large yellow/orange graphic and similar colorful patterned trim. Both appear to be reusable cloth diapers with elasticized leg openings.
